title: ML Shadow Mode & Model Agreement Dashboard
description: Production monitoring dashboard tracking model shadow agreement rates, p99 latency deltas, and prediction divergence between champion and candidate models across 24h traffic.

panels.title: 24h Shadow Agreement Rate vs Promotion Gate (92%)

targets.query: SELECT COUNTIF(agrees) / COUNT(*) AS agreement_rate FROM `instacommerce-prod.analytics.ml_shadow_predictions` WHERE timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR)

SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(timestamp, HOUR) AS hour, model_name, COUNTIF(agrees) / COUNT(*) AS hourly_agreement_rate, COUNT(*) AS sample_count FROM `instacommerce-prod.analytics.ml_shadow_predictions` WHERE timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1 ASC

panels.title: Latency Comparison: Champion vs Shadow (p50, p95, p99)

targets.query: SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(timestamp, 5 MINUTE) AS time_bucket, APPROX_QUANTILES(champion_latency_ms, 100)[OFFSET(99)] AS champion_p99_latency_ms, APPROX_QUANTILES(shadow_latency_ms, 100)[OFFSET(99)] AS shadow_p99_latency_ms, AVG(latency_overhead_ms) AS avg_overhead_ms FROM `instacommerce-prod.analytics.ml_shadow_predictions` WHERE timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 ASC
SELECT score_delta FROM `instacommerce-prod.analytics.ml_shadow_predictions` WHERE timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AND score_delta IS NOT NULL
